verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an MCP server, a Console API and an HTTP API, but nothing mentions an official Statsig CLI. An API is a developer building block, not a CLI, so it earns no credit. A feature-flag and experimentation platform could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
